decisions.reason: The same-message clarification that font details are included without a separate guidelines project is already fully represented by the candidate's message 39 MODIFY.
The separate message 39 decision limiting delivery to full-colour, black, and white variants is already fully represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
Clarifying the included brand-colour reference details does not change the requirement to supply fully editable source files or their intended applications.
The clarification about colour details and the exclusion of a separate guidelines document does not alter delivery of versions with and without the black box.
The source clarifies documentation of the approved colours, not the approved graduated-orange and black treatments used in the logo.
The brand-colour documentation clarification does not change rev8-11 as the approved final composition.
The source does not change the strapline's side lines or graduated-colour presentation.
The clarification of included brand-colour details has no necessary effect on the approved letterform requirements.
The source does not alter the company name, exclusion of the word 'truck,' or the logo's wider-business representation.
The documentation clarification does not affect the flame-based O or its recognition requirement.
Including colour codes rather than a separate guidelines document does not change the logo's clean, characterful visual-style balance.
The source concerns final brand-reference deliverables and does not change the completed initial-concept requirements.
